notes.title: Juggle Masters: Krav Maga Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27169947/f43dd19cd1c8df7b94389c9e0770c4c9a7825d31.png[/img]
[i]Featuring our newest [b]"Juggle Masters"[/b] Event!
[i][i]For this edition, we'll be seeing what you can do with the Sacred Scroll "Krav Maga".
[i]This will be a recurring event. The possibilities are endless![/i][/i][/i][/i]

[b]Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*]Only the following Sacred Scroll can be used: [b]Krav Maga[/b]
[*]Your juggle video must clearly show your in game name and user interface to prevent identity fraud.
[*]You may not use hacks or 3rd party programs that enhance your game play, stats, or physics of the game.
[*]You may use any various systems implemented in the training system such as training bot teleportation and modifying the training bot to do various moves.
[*]With that said, you do not have to use training mode. You may use a human player as your juggle subject.
[*]The human player can do things to influence your juggle like preemptively jump to start a juggle combo or attack for "counter-launchers".
[*]Your video must be uploaded either on YouTube or Vimeo.
[*]Your entry must be signed by your in game name in your entry post.
[*]If you change your in game name before the prize distribution, you forfeit in game prizes rewarded.
[*]Participation prize will be graded by effort, but ideally you will prove that you can do more than just a standard juggle combo, such as resetting your juggle combo through various platforms and terrain.
[*]ExoCores may be used to aid your juggle, but must not take away that you must highlight using the scroll itself.
[*]If you have more than one existing forum title, you may have to remove a forum title to make room for the new one.
[list]
[*]If this is the case, we will request for your permission to adjust it in a forum PM.
[/list]
[*]Prizes are not tiered. You will only get the prize in your tier.
[/list]
[b]Prizes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Grand Prize:[/b] "Krav Maga Master" Forum Title, 2500 RC, and featured on Facebook.
[*][b]2nd & 3rd:[/b] "Juggle Champion" Forum Title, 1500 RC, and featured on Facebook.
[*][b]Participation Prize: [/b]Krav Maga Title (30 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lQByhcb.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Event Duration: [/b]May 12, 2022 - June 17, 2022
[b]Community Voting: [/b]To be determined

[i]The only light to destroy the darkness.[/i]

The realm of Rumble Fighter needs the power of our Fighters to cast out the advancing, eternal darkness! The only light strong enough to pierce the darkness comes from Gemstones.  Help us defeat the looming evil that will swallow up the light!

notes.title: The Gift of Thanks
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pwiZwal.jpg[/img]
[i]The best gift of the season is the Gift of Thanks.[/i]

Despite the ongoing pandemic, there's still a lot to be thankful for. Our Rumble Fighter Team, for example, is grateful for all of our players, new and old, for your continuing support and love.  We hope that you can be thankful for your fellow players as well! This Thanksgiving, share your thanks with one friend on Rumble Fighter. You can only receive and give to 1 player however, so make sure to choose the friend you are most thankful for!

[h1]Event Rules: [/h1][list]
[*]Gifting and Receiving must be done between two players.  Gifting and Receiving will not count towards the event if you Gift to / Receive from multiple players.  
[*]Players will be required to post a screenshot of their gift box AND indicate the recipient of the gift.  The gift message must contain "The Gift of Thanks" or somehow indicate that it is for this event.  Also, the IGN of the Recipient must be included in the post for clarification.  
[*]On the forum post, please also leave a brief letter/message stating your thankfulness towards the player.  If you have gifted multiple items, please also make sure to include each gift for verification. 
[*]Rewards will be cumulative, meaning if you qualify to receive the "Orichalcon Coupon Package", you will also qualify for the lower tiered rewards.  
[*]Any IGN changes before event prizes are distributed MUST be mentioned via a Support Ticket. If you do not receive your prize for having changed your IGN, the prizes will be revoked and not corrected. In short, please let our staff know about the IGN change to make the necessary changes before sending out prizes.

notes.title: Boss Mode Rush: Assault
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Tqexkv.png[/img]
[i]Boss Mode Rush is back on! Claim your Battle Flags now![/i]

Experience the Boss Mode Rush, a challenging trial where you and your team must battle against hordes of monsters while completing the objectives.  Trust us when we say that you will not get it down on your first attempt.  Grab your best gear and speed into the Boss Mode Rush.



[h1]Boss Mode Rush: Assault[/h1]
[u][b]Assault Mode[/b][/u] - Defeat all of the androids (and boss) in Neo Alchemist City Boss Modes within 550 seconds under specific criteria.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pAfDhaL.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/2OigChL.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/qrcGrGi.png[/img]


[b]D-H-14 (Hell):[/b] Boss must be defeated with the "Machine Gun" pouch item or item pickup.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, Question Title (45 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mSzRhpT.png[/img]

[b]D-H-SBASE (Hell):[/b] You [u][b]cannot[/b][/u] fall off the map at any time.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, So What Tee (M/F) (Permanent)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hW0uOP3.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/tuEjlqO.png[/img]

[b]D-H-CORE (Hell): [/b]All Players' HPs cannot fall below 50%.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, Exclamation TItle (45 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OImLd0v.png[/img]

[u][b]AND[/b][/u]

[b]Completion Prize*[/b]:  Fighter's Battle Flag
*Can receive prize if valid submission shows completion of all three maps 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/59YJjWk.png[/img]

[h1]Event Duration:[/h1] [list]
[*]August 4th, 2020 00:00 PDT - August 31st, 2020 23:59 PDT[/list]

[h1]Prize Distribution:[/h1] [list]
[*]3 - 5 business days after the event concludes[/list]

[h1]Invincible Battle Flag and King's Battle Flag Upgrade: [/h1]
If you have two Fighter's Battle Flags, you may send in a ticket to redeem an Invincible Battle Flag. This time around, however, you may also send in a ticket to replace two Invincible Battle Flags for the next tier, King's Battle Flag. Once you have received the upgrade, the previous two flags will be removed from your inventory.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fGWCkei.png[/img]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/lQYBswu.png[/img]

=========================

Players must complete the Boss Modes with a team of up to 4 players total. As stated in the Event Rules, maps must be in Hell Mode, no ExoCores, and no revives of any sorts.  We encourage players to designate one player to be in charge of recording the run(s).  In order to ensure an organized thread, please write out every players' IGN and consolidate all videos into one post. Make sure to read the rules to better understand the event.

[h1]Event Rules:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Boss Mode must be run in Hell difficulty.
[*]No ExoCores may be used unless stated otherwise.
[*]You may only perform the task with a maximum of 4 players.
[*]Only one submission per team. Make sure to submit all videos into the same post.
[*]The use of a Verda’s Coin or Soulstone to revive yourself and other teammates is not allowed.
[*]All participating IGNs must be written out on the forum post.
[*]If any glitching, hacking or exploits is used, offenders will be subject to a 30+ day in-game ban and a disqualification from the event.
[*]You must adhere to the RedFox Games’ Terms of Service.
[*]All participants must be active in the challenge.
[/list]
[h1]Event Requirements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Boss Mode run must be recorded or streamed and saved in a VOD (or uploaded onto YouTube).
[*]The video must be accessible to the public and will be reviewed by a RedFox Games staff member.
[*]The video must start at room lobby and end after the scoreboard finishes.
[*]The video cannot be edited (must be raw video).
[*]You may not speed up or slow down the video in any way, shape or form.
[*]Your video submission will be posted on this thread. Multiple videos MUST be within the same post to count (multiple posts will be deleted)
[*]Please make sure video submissions are of completed runs; this means that you should check your work before submitting it onto the thread.
[/list]
[h1]Submission and Event Thread Notice:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Questions, comments, and concerns regarding this event can be directed to a [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/boss-mode-rush-questions-and-feedback.49151/]separate thread[/url] that will be provided in General Discussion.
[*]Any content posted on this thread that does not specifically pertain to the event will be removed from this thread.  (ie "res", "bump", etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: Un-BEAR-able Summer
notes.content:
[i][img]https://i.imgur.com/UeftpTG.png[/img]
This Polar Bear knows how to beat the heat![/i]

Hang 10, Fighters! Surfing polar bears are hard to come by, even rarer to embody one.  Cool off from the summer heat with a playtime event for the Polar Bear Set (30 Days) and a permanent Knu ExoCore! The event will be sectioned into four weeks, each with different parts for the Polar Bear Set and Knu.  After each week, the prizes will be distributed and the next objectives will begin.

notes.title: Hottest Summer Couple - Fashionista Event
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hjDM6Gj.png[/img]
[i]The competition is getting fired up![/i]

Show off your coolest and most refreshing outfits for this summer’s hottest Fashionista Event! Grab your partner and plan the best summer getup to earn the rightful title as the “Hottest Summer Couple”. Bring your A-game and scorch the competition!

[b]Event Prizes:[/b]
[list]
[*]First Place - 1,000 RC & "Hottest Summer Couple" Forum Title & 5 Orichalcon
[*]Second Place - 500 RC & "Hottest Runner Ups" Forum Title & 3 Orichalcon
[*]Third Place - 50,000 Carats & 3 Orichalcon
[*]Participation - 1 Orichalcon
[/list]
[b]Event Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*]Take a screenshot with a partner in your best, summer outfits as a couple.  Entries must have two players (no more, no less) wearing summer related "Couple's Outfits".  ([u]Screenshots with more or less than two players will be disqualified[/u])
[*]"Couple's Outfits" should have a theme and a sense of coordination between the two players.
[*]A "Couple" can be any combination of males and/or females.
[*]All entries must include the In-Game Names of both players in the screenshot (Limit 1 entry per account - one player cannot appear in two different entries)
[*]Outfits must relate to the Summer theme, unless there is an explanation for why your outfit works for the theme.
[*]Photo-editing programs are appreciated, but will not give you an advantage.
[*]There is no need to list out items used in the outfits.
[*]Placement prizes will be delivered as two
[list]
[*]For example - First place winners will each get 1,000 RC, Title, and Orichalcon.
[/list]
[*]Prizes will be distributed 3 - 5 days after the event has concluded.
[/list]
[b]Event Duration:[/b]
[list]
[*]Wednesday, June 17, 2020 00:00 PDT  -  Monday, July 20, 2020 18:00 PDT
[/list]

Tips on getting the perfect picture:
[list]
[*]Press "Page Up" to hide your UI
[*]If you know how to use Photoshop, now is the time to show us your skills
[*]BE CREATIVE!
[/list]

[i]Love is tough sometimes.[/i]

[*]The use of a video-editing program is encouraged, but is not necessary.  Customize your video in any way you would like as long as it is appropriate.

notes.title: [EVENT] Winter Northern Lights - Enchantment
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yatIPwQ.png[/img]
[i]A brilliant radiance pierces the Rumble Fighter sky![/i]

[h1]Enchantment Part I[/h1]
As a small incentive for players to enchant successfully to +10, we are giving everyone an opportunity to receive 2 Master Cards every day for one week. All you have to do is simply enchant any Gem from +1 to +5 during the Part I event period. You are limited to 2 Master Cards per day, but you can earn up to 14 cards if you successfully enchant from every day.

[b]Part I Time Slots: [/b]
Enchanting for Part I must take place between these times (server time)[list]
[*]11 AM PST - 1 PM PST
[/list]
[b]Part I Rules:[/b][list]
[*]Gem used for Part I [b]must[/b] start from +1 for each day. It does not matter which gem you use, however. 
[*]Enchanting must happen in the time period mentioned above. 
[*]Zircon of Health must go from +40 to +200. Tanzanite of Mana must go from +12 to +60. 
[*]Enchanting does not need to succeed all at once. As long as your starting point is at +1 and it eventually gets to +5, it will qualify to receive 2 Master Enchant Cards.
[*]you may continually use one gem by downgrading it and upgrading it during this time.
[/list]
[b]Part I Prizes:[/b][list]
[*]2 Master Enchant Cards 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OymuVrW.png[/img]
[*]Daily limit = 2 cards; Total = 14 Master Enchant Cards
[/list]
[b]Event Duration:[/b][list]
[*]December 21st 11:00 PST - December 27th 13:00 PST
[/list]
Prize Distribution:[list]
[*]3 - 5 business days after event concludes
[/list]

[h1]Enchantment Part II[/h1]
[b]Event Rules:[/b][list]
[*]Successfully enchant any level gem to +10 during this event period. 
[*]Enchanting only applies to Ruby of Power (+10), Obsidian of Defense (+10), and Zircon of Health (+400). 
[*]You may only win the main prize once during the event period.
[*]At the end of the event, your gem must remain at +10 or +400. Any changes to it afterwards will result in a disqualification.
[*]GMs will personally send you an email with your prize request list, so please do not send in a ticket requesting your Grand Prize.
[/list]

[/list]

[h1]Event Rules:[/h1]
[list]

[*]No ExoCores may be used unless stated otherwise.
[*]You may only perform the task with a maximum of 4 players.
[*]Only one submission per team. Make sure to submit all videos into the same post.  
[*]The use of a Verda’s Coin or Soulstone to revive yourself is not allowed.
[*]All participating IGNs must be written out on the forum post.
[*]If any glitching, hacking or exploits is used, offenders will be subject to a 30+ day in-game ban and a disqualification from the event.
[*]You must adhere to the RedFox Games’ Terms of Service.
[*]All participants must be active in the challenge.
[/list]
[h1]Event Requirements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Boss Mode run must be recorded or streamed and saved in a VOD (or uploaded onto YouTube).
[*]The video must be accessible to the public and will be reviewed by a RedFox Games staff member.
[*]The video must start at room lobby and end after the scoreboard finishes.
[*]The video cannot be edited (must be raw video).
[*]You may not speed up or slow down the video in any way, shape or form.
[*]Your video submission will be posted on this thread. Multiple videos MUST be within the same post to count (multiple posts will be deleted)
[*]Please make sure video submissions are of completed runs; this means that you should check your work before submitting it onto the thread.
[/list]
[b]Submission and Event Thread Notice:[/b]
[list]
[*]Questions, comments, and concerns regarding this event can be directed to a separate thread that will be provided in General Discussion.
[*]Any content posted on this thread that does not specifically pertain to the event will be removed from this thread.  (ie "res", "bump", etc.)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/acf4c80.png[/img]

[*]The Tome or Jade will randomly select a permanent or timed scroll, if you have multiples of the scroll.
[/list]

Here is a complete list of all 68 Sacred Scrolls that are available for Ascension.

notes.title: [EVENT] Fashionista Tournament!
notes.content:
[I][IMG]https://i.imgur.com/ckERyZ4.png[/IMG] 
Think you got the best outfit in town?  Let the community be the judge of that.
[/I]

[h1]Objective:[/h1]
Think you got the best looking outfit in game?  Join in on the first ever Rumble Fighter Fashionista Tournament! Post your best looking outfit in game, pretty it up with a little photo editing, and post it right here.  If you think you got what it takes, you may take the 1st place spot!

[h1]How it works:[/h1]
The first 64 participants who post an outfit will be entered in a Fashionista showdown.  Your outfit will directly compete against one other person's outfit to move on to the next round.  Your outfit must follow all the rules to make it into the tournament.

You will only provide one outfit, and that one outfit will determine whether or not you make it or break it.

[h1]How will voting work:[/h1]
Everyone can participate by voting.  Simply vote for the outfit you think looks better, provide your in game name, and you're complete until the next round.  Voting will take place in a "Google Form", so make sure to include your in game name.

[h1]Fashionista Rules:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Outfits created must be rated PG-13 or under.  Use common sense, but ultimately your outfit is subject to GM discretion.
[*]Blatant copies of character designs from other franchises may result in a disqualification (example: Rock Lee from Naruto, Goku from Dragon Ball, and so on).
[*]You must use items you already own.
[*]You may edit your photos using Photoshop or any other photo editing software.  Free Photoshop alternatives can be found here: [URL]https://www.techradar.com/news/the-best-free-photoshop-alternative[/URL]
[*]You must list every single item used.
[*]You must include your in game name in your entry.  If you do not want to include your in game name, please use the forum account associated with your Rumble Fighter account.  If for whatever reason, your forum account associated with your Rumble Fighter account is banned, you must provide your in game name, if you would like the prize.
[*]If you are not part of the first 64, you still may submit an outfit for a "Fashionista Participation Prize".
[*]All reservation posts will be deleted.
[/LIST]
[h1]Voting Rules:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]One person per vote.  If we catch multiple accounts, we may revoke the votes on our side.
[*]You must vote on every single entry.
[*]If you want the participation prize, you must provide your in game name.
[/LIST]
[h1]Distribution & Distribution Rules:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]You may not change your in game name until the prize is distributed.  If you change your in game name before then, your prize is forfeited.
[*]Distribution will happen within 5 business days of the event ending.
[/LIST]
[h1]Prizes:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*][b]1st Place:[/b] Fashion Master Forum Title, Fashionista Title (in game), 1000 RC, plus participation prize
[*][b]2nd Place:[/b] Fashion King/Queen Forum Title, Fashionista Title (in game), plus participation prize
[*][b]3rd/4th Place:[/b] Fashion Veteran Forum Title, Fashionista Title (in game), plus participation prize
[*][b]5th - 64th Place:[/b] Participation Prize - Orichalcon Stone
[*][b]Voting Participation Prize:[/b] Orichalcon Stone
[/LIST]

notes.title: [EVENT] Rumble Fighter: World Records (Boss Mode)
notes.content:
[I][IMG]https://i.imgur.com/VPslo71.png[/IMG] 
Face up against the most competitive PvE Rumble Fighter players ever in a test of time.  Can you beat the World Record?  Think again.
[/I]

[h1]Details:[/h1]
World Records Boss Mode edition will feature an ongoing World Records run for specific Boss Modes.  At the end of each month, the World Record's team will receive 1,000 RC per team member.  Each team can have a maximum of 4 players.

Each month, we will be featuring a different boss mode, however due to the finite amount of nonseasonal boss modes, we will be constantly revisiting all the different boss modes.  Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Good luck!

[h1]Requirements:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Boss Mode must be recorded or streamed with a saved VOD.  The video must be accessible to the public and will be pending review of the Rumble Fighter team staff.
[*]All boss mode runs must follow all RedFox Games' terms of service meaning, but not limited to: no hacking and exploiting.
[*]Video must not be sped up or slowed down in any way, shape, or form.
[*]Your submission will be on this thread.  Please see submission guidelines below.
[/LIST]
[h1]Rules:[/h1]

notes.content:
[I]A new kind of tournament has arrived.  RedFox Games' first moving screen tournament debuts now![/I]

[h1]Tournament Sign Ups:[/h1]
Click this picture to be sent to the sign up page.
[URL='https://www.playredfox.com/rumble_fighter/tournament_submission'][IMG]https://i.imgur.com/F4IkDl3.png[/IMG][/URL]

[h1]How will I be chosen?[/h1]
Featured Demolition players and invited players will be contacted via e-mail by an official @playredfox.com or rumblefighter@redfox.freshdesk.com e-mail [B]and[/B] forum PM. If you have not been featured, you can increase your chances by:
[LIST]
[*]Increase your in game activity in the next 7 days
[*]Known and vouched as a great team player by the members of the community
[*]Known and vouched for as a great player in general by the members of the community
[/LIST]
The rest will be randomly selected.  [I]There will be 64 participants.

[B]Please make sure to check the e-mail sender.  Make sure it is sent from a @playredfox.com e-mail OR rumblefighter@redfox.freshdesk.com.  If it is neither and they are advertising for an official Rumble Fighter Tournament, please report them for fraud.[/B]
[/I]
[h1]How will I know I have been chosen?[/h1]
You will be e-mailed by an official @playedfox.com or rumblefighter@redfox.freshdesk.com.

[h1]Sign Up Dates:[/h1]
End on February 24th, 2019, 11:59:59 PST

[h1]Sign Up Rules:[/h1]
[LIST=1]
[*]You will only have one chance to submit your in game name.  Make sure it is spelled correctly.
[*]In game name changes before the tournament will result in a forfeit for your slot.
[*][B]YOUR IN GAME NAME MUST MATCH THE ACCOUNT YOU ARE SIGNING UP WITH.  THIS RULE WILL BE STRICTLY ENFORCED.[/B]
[/LIST]
[h1]Tournament Rules:[/h1]
[LIST=1]
[*]Sacred Scroll Ban List: Any scroll that is not in the shop cannot be used.
[*]No ExoCores can be used.
[*]All active pouch item pouch items can be used.
[*]No stat boosting passive pouch items can be used.
[*]Avalon Drivers cannot be used.
[*]Back-Guard items and Rebirth may be used.
[*]Stalling tactics such as excessively running away or constant hit and run tactics will result in a round forfeit (up to the GM discretion).
[*]You may switch scrolls every match (1 match = 3 rounds).  If a round is interrupted by disconnection, need to restart, or any other problem, that specific match will be counted towards scroll switches.  For example: if a round needs to be restarted, that round will still count towards switching scrolls, but will not count towards your winning total.
[*]All matches [B]up to quarter finals[/B] will be [B]first to win 3 rounds[/B].
[*][B]Quarter Finals[/B] will be [B]first to win 5 rounds.[/B]
[*][B]Semi-Finals and and above[/B] will be [B]first to win 9 rounds.[/B]
[*]The only map that will be played will be "Moving Screen: Demolition".
[*]Stat limits:
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]STR, ARM, SPD, JMP must be 30 or below
[*]HP must be 3000 or below
[*]Critical can be used, but only up to 100.
[/LIST]
[h1]General Rules:[/h1]
[LIST=1]
[*]Keep flaming and trash talk to a minimum.  Tilt tactics will not be tolerated under official tournaments.
[*]In game name changes after you have signed up will forfeit any prizes or qualification into the tournament.  Once you receive your prizes, you may change your in game name as usual though.
[*]Cheating in any form will result in automatic disqualification and removal of your prizes on your account, and in some instances may result in a ban.  Cheating is, but not limited to: any form of hacking, having another player log into your account to 1 vs 1 for you, using hacked or exploited item sets or stats.
[*]You may not vouch for yourself.  If you're great at something, they will tell you.
[/LIST]

notes.title: [EVENT] Guild Wars: The First Invitational
notes.content:
[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/aFNrJt4.png[/IMG]

[h1]Guild Wars: The First Invitationals[/h1]
[I]Think you're the best Rumble Fighter leader in the world? Think again. Earn as much ladder points as you can, and if you're one of the highest ladder point earners, you will be selected in a small scale 3 vs 3 tournament.[/I]

[h1]Objective:[/h1]
Earn as many ladder points as you can. If you are one of the top, you will be personally selected in a private 3 vs 3 guild tournament.

[h1]How do I get accepted?[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Follow and abide to the rules listed below.
[*]Individual players who earn the most amount of ladder points will be selected to choose 2 members from their guild to participate in the future guild tournament.
[*]Only one team per guild.
[/LIST]
[h1]Rules:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Your ladder point gain will be based on your [B]end result[/B], not your peak result. For example, if you start at 1000 ladder points, earn up to 1050, but drop down to 1025 by the end of the event, your ladder point gain is 25.
[*]All players with suspicious ladder point gains will be investigated. Please do not cheat your way into this tournament.
[*]Win trading, playing versus alternate accounts, and/or all other forms of ladder point boosting strategies are banned. We expect all participants to earn ladder points through hard fought games.
[*]All reports of "DDoS" will be investigated and all violators will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.
[*]The guild channel will be monitored privately and cheating players will be automatically disqualified. This will be done at the GMs discretion. Players will not be informed when they're being monitored and if they get disqualified until after the event is done.
[*]You agree and will follow all RedFox Games terms and services.
[*]You play with the upmost sportsmanship. It's a fighting game, some banter is allowed, but no serious insults.
[*]If you are one of the selected participants to join the guild tournament, you may not join a guild that has an invite, unless you wish to forfeit your invite.
[*]If you are one of the selected participants to join the guild tournament, you may join another guild that does not have an invite, but your selected teammates will have to join the different guild as well.
[*]Forum Titles will go towards the forum account your Rumble Fighter character is connected to. If you have a main forum account separate from your Rumble Fighter account, you will not receive the forum title.
[*]Grand Prize does not extend to chosen Team Mates.
[/LIST]
[h1]Duration:[/h1]
January 16th - 31st, 2019

[h1]Prizes:[/h1]
[b]Grand Prize:[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Forum Title - Guild War Master, Guild Tournament Invitation
[*]Knight of Death Title (Perm)
[*]Everything listed below (besides forum title)
[/LIST]
[b]Over 50 LP:[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Forum Title - Guild War Veteran
[*]League Promotion Shirt (Male/Female)
[*]Iron Slam Title
[/LIST]
[b]Over 10 LP:[/b]
[LIST]
[*]10,000 Carats
[/LIST]

notes.title: October 2018 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/2c503673bd4f7d552b5c981f59fd76394d62c24e.png[/img]
Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes are taking place this maintenance.

October 1st update is here, you know what that means it’s officially Halloween month! Check out all the exclusive Halloween items available at the store, including the Skeleton Box Package! We also have a new Crasher Scroll, along with some updates on the Medal Shop/ Orichalcon Ticket items!

New Crasher Scroll is now available at the store. Check out the video preview below to see it in action:

Halloween Items at the store are now live! We have several Halloween costume packages, accessories, and much more!

[B]Halloween Skeleton Box Contents:[/B]

Halloween Hell Cat Costume Pieces and Nightmare Claw ExoCore inside the Halloween Skeleton Box:

Halloween Cutie Costumes are back in the store for a limited time.
[LIST]
[*]Halloween Cutie Witch Package (M)
[*]Halloween Cutie Witch Package (F)
[*]Halloween Cutie Zombie Package (M)
[*]Halloween Cutie Zombie Package (F)
[/LIST]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/ebb4fc269875668f777637d887a64ac7b858c6e8.png[/img]

Dummy Costumes (Carats) are also available at the store:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/fa20da98b2e36594bd8d84904ee88e1fd1b3626a.png[/img]
The Halloween Cursed, Blazing , and Frightening Costumes are also back at the store!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/919a8ca65cfc1eb475908eb3d961cd3bacc95fc8.png[/img]
Fortune Package and Chest have returned to the store for a limited time!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/dc6c8ea5d44f153b51035fe7109af849fb20c535.png[/img]
Phantom Walker and Seal of Zodiac – Gemini Package are also back for this update.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/938a2248769d8cd0a2cd3d6b8fbc10b7b43ef70b.png[/img]


New Capricornus ExoCore can be obtain through the Seal of the Zodiac – Capricornus Box/Package:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/213d6a827b53ea21b4eac33934eae95f041718f1.png[/img]
New Seal of Zodiac - Capricornus Box/ Packages are now available at the store.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/644907fc659ef29cf616a08e491c913e673ec300.png[/img]

[B]Medal Shop[/B] have some New Ticket Items for the month of October. These Tickets can be used to combine with Orichalcon to receive 1 of the current sale boxes or an exclusive [B]Orichalcon ExoCore and Scroll Box.[/B]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/814db00fbd4ede7276100f61917d64cd91853bf1.png[/img]

Orichalcon Scroll and ExoCore Boxes are still available
[B]Orichalcon: [/B]Can be earned through Login Attendance Event or you can purchase RE Packaged Scroll which contains 7x Orichalcon on each package.

UPDATE: [/B]New Enigma Carat Chest have been updated to include some of the SE (timed) scrolls to make it easier for players to obtain and combine for SE permanent scrolls.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/7P03m5h.png[/IMG]
[B]New Changes on the Brave Mode Mechanics[/B] will now be activated at [B]30% or below[/B] instead of 15%.
Players can really test their skills with the Brave Mode activated slightly earlier for a chance to make a comeback.

[B]New Air Forward-Roll Function:[/B]
Ability to control the posture when being attacked (Mid-air).
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must have an extra Panic Attack remaining
[*]Click P + K (Panic Attack command) simultaneously while attacked in the mid-air transition of jump and down attack.
[/LIST]
[B]New Gameplay Mechanics Added:
Brave Mode:[/B]

Once your HP start flickering there is an automatic attack boost so you can decide to be brave and risky. You will still need to be skillful at attacking since your health is still 15%, but this will allow you to possibly make a comeback win.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]HP must be lower than 30%
[*]Panic/Dying Condition (HP lower than 30%) – HP will be flickering.
[*]Attack hit will increase (Attack Boost) (Auto active. Regardless of class or level)
[/LIST]
[B]Super Arts Function (RE Scrolls Exclusive):[/B]
Able to cast special attack to inflict great damage without transforming into an ExoCore.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must meet the Guardian requirement
[*]Equip an scroll RE activated scroll to cast Super Arts
[*]Brave Mode (HP lower than 15%)
[*]Can only be used 1x per Round
[*]Hit "B" to execute the Super Arts
[/LIST]
[B]Super Arts RE Scroll List:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Black Tortoise RE
[*]Shaolin Tiger RE
[*]Yellow Dragon RE
[*]Vermilion Phoenix RE
[*]Rage RE
[*]The Blue Dragon RE
[*]White Tiger RE
[/LIST]
[B]Note:[/B] Brave Mode will end if the Super Arts is activated (regardless of it being successful or failed attempt)

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/0pqopyx.png[/IMG]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/275492901fb6551f04d8222d90f190da6fa6f812.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/36c64e035c7502976eb029ce34b144bd7434486c.jpg[/img]
More Halloween Events coming soon!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/58vJEzF.png[/IMG]
[LIST]
[*]Motion of Seal of Zodiac – Capricornus Skill A has been revised and enhanced. Attack range has been expanded. Abnormal motions are fixed. Inflict FX has been changed.
[*]Halloween Hellcat Skill A & B are being enhanced. Attack range has been expanded. Damage/Buff amount have increased.
[*]Hondon Scroll FX effects are (partially) added on Hondon attack motions. Attack range has been expanded.
[/LIST]

notes.title: September 2018 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/2cfc43996497b2428cf43323dd6ea6e9a2d7ea78.png[/img]
Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes are taking place this maintenance.

As most of the community already know, we have been making some changes on our server infrastructure. We will continue to gather some more feedback from the community regarding the latency or lag issue.

Now for some exciting announcements! We finally have a Design a Costume Contest winner: FluffySheep/Stockings!!! We are excited to finally be able to release the costume in game!

We also have a couple of new skill items: Hondon Scroll and the Capricornus ExoCore!

As part of the Seal of the Zodiac Capricornus Box/Package there will also be a Capricornus Knight Costume Set. You can start collecting all the costume pieces and the Capricornus ExoCore!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ADNGkt9.png[/IMG]
Summer is almost over! Our 2nd update for the month of September is here! Check out some new skill items: Hondon Scroll and Capricornus ExoCore previews.

New Hondon Scroll is now available in the store!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/7cf6b5660b2f111c7df80343132d15492e0ff107.png[/img]


New Capricornus ExoCore can be obtain through the Seal of the Zodiac – Capricornus Box/Package:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/25e520d65109b358e02e663ffd0228a84f12da23.png[/img]

New Seal of Zodiac - Capricornus Box/ Packages are now available at the store.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/6ab84c4c37c7d942ff2c674bf61c680e07b8eea1.jpg[/img]
New user created costumes: Stocking Maid and Noble Butler Costume Sets. Special thanks to FluffySheep/Stockings as the Design a Costume Contest winner! Costume sets are now available at the store, make sure you change your class (M) or (F) to see the Stocking Maid (F) and Noble Butler (M) Costume Sets.

Stocking Maid and Noble Butler Costume Sets Preview:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/e9947fc754523576612b8029345dc1d513b788e6.png[/img]

New Imperial Performer ExoCore is now available in the store!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/91ca4a73368aa4b4223b3e8054db1b1ab980aca8.png[/img]

[B]Medal Shop[/B] still have some New Ticket Items for the month of September. These Tickets can be used to combine with Orichalcon to receive 1 of the current sale boxes or an exclusive [B]Orichalcon ExoCore and Scroll Box.[/B]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/2f3a962ac7b6134b7420db8122bc07c4733febfd.png[/img]

Orichalcon Scroll and ExoCore Boxes are still available

[B]Orichalcon: [/B]Can be earned through Login Attendance Event or you can purchase RE Packaged Scroll which contains 7x Orichalcon on each package. 

[B]
UPDATE: [/B]New Enigma Carat Chest have been updated to include some of the SE (timed) scrolls to make it easier for players to obtain and combine for SE permanent scrolls.

[B]
Summer Box and Packages Sale continues with a new line up for September 2018![/B]
Inferno Chest and Package are back on sale to start off the summer for a limited time!
[LIST]
[*]Inferno Chest
[*]Inferno Package
[/LIST]
The Seal of the Zodiac – Cancer / Package are also on sale now!
[LIST]
[*]Seal of the Zodiac – Cancer
[*]Seal of the Zodiac – Cancer Package
[/LIST]
Shadow Fox Corps Box / 10Pack
[LIST]
[*]Shadow Fox Corps Box
[*]Shadow Fox Corps Box 10Pack
[/LIST]
‘Katanas of Darkness’ KOD Set is also back on sale for a limited time.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/7P03m5h.png[/IMG]
[B]Super Arts RE Scroll List:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Black Tortoise RE
[*]Shaolin Tiger RE
[*]Yellow Dragon RE
[*]Vermilion Phoenix RE
[*]Rage RE
[*]The Blue Dragon RE
[*]White Tiger RE
[/LIST]
[B]New Air Forward-Roll Function:[/B]
Ability to control the posture when being attacked (Mid-air).
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must have an extra Panic Attack remaining
[*]Click P + K (Panic Attack command) simultaneously while attacked in the mid-air transition of jump and down attack.
[/LIST]
[B]New Gameplay Mechanics Added:
Brave Mode:[/B]
Once your HP start flickering there is an automatic attack boost so you can decide to be brave and risky. You will still need to be skillful at attacking since your health is still 15%, but this will allow you to possibly make a comeback win.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]HP must be lower than 15%
[*]Panic/Dying Condition (HP lower than 15%) – HP will be flickering.
[*]Attack hit will increase (Attack Boost) (Auto active. Regardless of class or level)
[/LIST]
[B]Super Arts Function (RE Scrolls Exclusive):[/B]
Able to cast special attack to inflict great damage without transforming into an ExoCore.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must meet the Guardian requirement
[*]Equip an scroll RE activated scroll to cast Super Arts
[*]Brave Mode (HP lower than 15%)
[*]Can only be used 1x per Round
[*]Hit "B" to execute the Super Arts
[/LIST]
[B]Note:[/B] Brave Mode will end if the Super Arts is being used while HP is lower than 15% (regardless of it being successful or failed attempt)

notes.title: What's New? August Update #2
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Sqg2yO6.png[/IMG]
Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes are taking place this maintenance.

Mainly a small update this week with new Dowul Scroll. We also added an additional returning D-H-14 Boss Mode for players to obtain the Red Scorpion (Ver Summer Festival) and Ice Breaker (Ver Summer Festival) as requested by player who want to retrieve the combination items. There was an issue with having two Boss Mode Maps but the developers have been able to fix it so we have both Rabbit's Lair and D-H-14 War Boss Mode for the rest of the August update.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ADNGkt9.png[/IMG]
August 2018 2nd Update is here!

New Dowul Scroll is available at the store make sure that you check out the video preview update below to see the scroll in action.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/a38b60c53a50476918c686eea34b015e378d024b.png[/img]

To view the preview of the scroll, please [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VbD1w-_o2CU]watch this.[/url]
 
The Black Tortoise RE and Shaolin Tiger RE are no longer available at the store but can still be obtain through the Rabbit’s Lair Boss Mode:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/80426d3a67bd9143a60d643e450f5501ee2a8265.png[/img]

[H1][B]Black Tortoise RE and Shaolin Tiger RE:[/B][/H1]
If you already have the normal Black Tortoise and Shaolin Tiger, Players can also upgrade/obtain these RE scrolls via Combination Formula in which they can obtain combination material through Rabbit’s Lair Boss Mode (Updated)!

[H1][B]Yellow Dragon RE:[/B][/H1]
Yellow Dragon RE Combination can only be obtain if you have the Yellow Dragon Scroll and will have additional material requirements than the regular RE Scrolls.

notes.title: [EVENT] Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament Reloaded Sign Ups
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/f459d8e7941a0745ab0261d675e7ddbeb582b059.png[/img]
[I]We have learned from our mistakes and want to bring the most exciting 1 vs 1 tournament to date.  Featured 1 vs 1 players will be personally invited.  Known players from far and wide will have their chance to take the trophy of the Rumble Royale Belt and Gladiator Set!  Will you have what it takes?[/I]

[B]Tournament Sign Ups:[/B]
[url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-summer-1-vs-1-tournament-reloaded-sign-ups.43930/] 1 vs 1 Sign Ups[/url]

[B]How will I be chosen?[/B]
Featured 1 vs 1 players will be contacted via e-mail by an official @playredfox.com e-mail [B]and[/B] forum PM.  You will only have to respond to one or the other.  If you have not been featured, you can increase your chances by:
[LIST]
[*]Increase your in game activity in the next 7 days
[*]Known and vouched as a great 1 vs 1 player by the members of the community
[*]Known and vouched for as a great player in general by the members of the community
[/LIST]
The rest will be randomly selected.  [I]There will be 64 participants.
[/I]
[B]How will I know I have been chosen?[/B]
You will be e-mailed by an official @playredfox.com e-mail.

[B]Sign Up Dates:[/B]
Until August 19th, 11:59:59 PST

[B]Tournament Rules:[/B]
[LIST=1]
[*]Sacred Scrolls Ban List: All scrolls that are not sold in the shop are banned except Fearless, Telos, Sumo, and Hung Gar.
[*]No ExoCores can be used.
[*]All active pouch items cannot be used such as but not limited to: all kinds of potions, Panic Attack +1, and all kinds of bombs.
[*]All passive pouch items that enhance fighting ability cannot be used such as but not limited to: eye of critical damage and magic runes.
[*]Avalon Drivers cannot be used.
[*]Back guard items cannot be used.
[*]Rebirth Passives can be used.
[*]Stalling tactics such as excessively running away or constant hit and run tactics will result in a round forfeit (up to the GM discretion).
[*]You will not be limited to one scroll.  You will be able to switch scrolls in between [I]matches[/I].  Each [I]match[/I] is 3 rounds.
[*]All matches up to the semi finals will be [I]Best of 3 Rounds[/I].
[*]Semi Finals will feature a "first to 3 rounds".  The winner will be decided who wins 3 rounds first.
[*]Finals will feature a "first to 9 rounds".  The winner will be decided who wins 9 rounds first.
[*]Stat limits:
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]STR, ARM, SPD, JMP must be 30 or below
[*]HP must be 3000 or below
[*]Critical can be used, but only up to 100.
[/LIST]
[B]General Rules:[/B]
[LIST=1]
[*]No trash talk and keep flaming to a minimum.  We understand this is a fighting game, but tilt tactics are not allowed.
[*]In game name changes after you have signed up will forfeit any prizes or qualification into the tournament.  Once you receive your prizes, you may change your in game name as usual though.
[*]Cheating in any form will result in automatic disqualification and removal of your prizes on your account, and in some instances may result in a ban.  Cheating is, but not limited to: any form of hacking, having another player log into your account to 1 vs 1 for you, using hacked or exploited item sets or stats.
[*]You may not vouch for yourself.  If you're great at something, they will tell you.
[/LIST]
[B]Tournament Format:[/B]
1 vs 1, Single Elimination

[B]Tournament Schedule:[/B]
August 20th: Top 64, 2:30 PM PST to 7:00 PM PST
August 21st - Top 64 Continued, 2:30 PM PST to 7:00 PM PST
August 22nd - Top 32, 3:00 PM PST to 7:00 PM PST
August 23rd - Top 16, 3:00 PM PST to 6:00 PM PST
August 24th - Quarter Finals, 3:00 PM PST to 5:00 PM PST
August 25th - Semi Finals & Finals, 4:00 PM PST to END

Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes were made this maintenance.

Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes are taking place this maintenance.

We are introducing a Level Up Boost Event where all players below Lv. 25, new players, or returning players are able to level up faster up to Lv. 25.

There are also some new RE Scrolls revisions: Vermilion Phoenix RE and Rage RE added (Super Arts Function) Check out the Gameplay Section below for more in-depth details.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ADNGkt9.png[/IMG]
July 2018 2nd Update is here! If you been wanting to Level up to 25 faster now is your chance! Make sure to check out the Level Up Boost Event.

There is also an updated Vermilion Phoenix RE and Rage RE that has exclusive Super Arts function. Check out the Video preview of these new features:  Check out the [url=https://youtu.be/4asWCSsao2o]Video[/url] preview of these new features:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/3999158c081778d036539018c0d8a15d2249ed00.jpg[/img]
[h1][B]
Vermilion Phoenix RE and Rage RE:[/B][/h1]

Vermilion Phoenix RE and Rage RE are both available at the store with packaged Orichalcon just like the previous RE scrolls.

If you already have the normal Vermilion Phoenix and Rage, Players can also upgrade/obtain these RE scrolls via Combination Formula in which they can obtain combination material through A Trip to the Graveyard Boss Mode (Updated)!

For further Orichalcon formulas and Box contents, head to  [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/7-24-2018-whats-new.43743/]What's New?[/url]

New user based designed scroll Heartseeker is still available at the store. Congrats to the Scroll Design Winner: @Shana
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/aa3810c7facd70d58b80eafcbdbd36f42ca835cc.png[/img]

Since we have a Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament coming up, we have compiled some New Tournament Packages available at the store with a great discounted prices plus a bonus item.

[B]July Additional Update: Super Arts RE Scroll List:[/B]

-Rage RE
-The Blue Dragon RE
-White Tiger RE

[B]Previous July Game Mechanics Update:[/B]
[h1][B]New Air Forward-Roll Function:[/B][/h1]
Ability to control the posture when being attacked (Mid-air).

[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must have an extra Panic Attack remaining

notes.title: [NOTICE] Network Maintenance: July 10, 2018 (02:00AM - 06:00AM PDT)
notes.content:
Hello Rumble Fighter Community,

We will undergo a network maintenance beginning at July 10, 2018 02:00 (2:00 AM PDT) It is expected to last for at least 4 hours until 6:00AM PDT.

As we have announced there were some issues with server stability that has resulted in numerous amount players disconnecting from Rumble Fighter. This issue was caused by DDoS attacks on our servers affecting all of our games. As a response, we will be implementing new system on the servers to hopefully prevent these DDoS attacks and stabilize our network servers.

During this period the servers will be open, but will be unstable. If you are disconnected from Rumble Fighter, simply restart and log back into the game. The servers will stay online for the remainder of the network maintenance duration. 

[h1] Network Maintenance Duration:[/h1]
Tuesday, July 10, 2018 at 02:00 AM (2:00AM) PDT - Tuesday July 10, 2018 at 06:00 AM (6:00AM) PDT

We apologize in advance for any inconvenience. Thank you for understanding the situation.

notes.title: [EVENT] Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament Qualification Event
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/0b52bbd547b5e6f5b4b7771cb72a4835f8e944d7.png[/img]
[I]Summer is just getting started, so lets kick up the heat with another tournament!  Individual skill is what it is all about.  Prepare yourself for the ultimate 1 vs 1 tournament of the year.  The grand prize will contain the legendary "Gladiator Set".  Do you even have what it takes to qualify?
[/I]

[h1]Event Qualification Dates:[/h1]
[B]July 6th, 2018 - July 15th, 2018[/B]

[h1][B]Event Qualification Requirements:[/B][/h1]
This 1 vs 1 tournament will not have any formal sign ups.  Fighters will have to complete a set of tasks in game to be considered.
[LIST=1]
[*]You must play 100 rounds of "True Battle Mode" or "Battle Mode" in a 1 vs 1 setting.
[*]You may play on any map, however the following maps will be taken into higher consideration: "Dungeon", "Rumble Dojo", and "Blacktop Melee".
[*]You may play with stats, items, runes, ExoCores, and etc. but we recommend you do not.  We intend for this tournament to be all about skill.
[*]You may use any and all scrolls, however the following scrolls will be banned in the actual tournament: (Tentative) Sage Master & all its variants.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]How will participants be chosen?[/B][/h1]
Fighters who fulfill the event qualification requirements will be selectively selected to participate in the 1 vs 1 tournament.  Fighters will have been selected for the tournament will receive an e-mail notification to their account.  The e-mail will be sent to the e-mail their account is registered with.  Additionally, in game names of all the selected applicants will be posted in the next post.

[h1][B]Rules and Guidelines:[/B][/h1]
[I]Rules and guidelines are subject to change at any given moment.  Rules will not be retroactively applied unless within reason.  By participating in this tournament, you acknowledge and agree to all the rules and guidelines listed in this tournament.  In addition, you agree to all of RedFox Games terms & service and all Rumble Fighter general rules and guidelines.  Failure to comply with everything listed will result in disqualification, removal from the prize list, and/or a potential ban.[/I]
[LIST=1]
[*]You must be level 15 or above and have the "Guardian Gem" in your inventory.  If you are level 15 and higher and are unable to get the Guardian Gem, please send a ticket to the help desk.  If you can use your "nanmu", you have the Guardian Gem.
[*]You will have to register your scroll for the first round of the tournament.  Once this scroll is registered, this will be the only scroll you can use for the duration of the tournament.
[*]For the whole duration of the tournament, all stats and items are banned.  The only items and passives allowed to influence your characters fighting ability are: your sacred scroll, your base class, and your rebirth passive.
[*]You may change your character look using "Avatar" but you must replace stat items with no stat items in your "Build-Up" section.
[*]Sacred Scroll Ban List: (Tentative) Sage Master & all its variants.
[*]Cheating, multiple entries, playing on multiple accounts,intentional disconnections, or having someone play on your account will be on grounds for immediate disqualification. If your account is found to have engaged in any of these activities, even after the tournament is over, your prizes will be revoked and you will be disqualified from future tournaments for the next 3 months.
[*]Any form of hacking, hacked gems or gemstones used in the tournament will result in an immediate disqualification without appeal. Users will have to submit evidence regarding this. Edited and cropped screenshots will not be allowed as evidence.
[*]Any evidence of stalling or abuse of hit and run tactics will disqualify the team (only applicable in the main tournament).
[*]The tournament will be done in a single elimination format.
[*]In game name changes will result an immediate disqualification and forfeit of all prizes.
[/LIST]

For further information regarding this tournament, please head to our [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-summer-1-vs-1-tournament-qualification-event.43450/]forums[/url]

notes.title: [Notice] Steam Launch Issue
notes.content:
Hello Rumble Fighters,

We are currently investigating the Steam Launch issue.

We have gathered files from affected players to try to locate a pattern to locate the issue.

Previously, some players who have reported the issue are now able to access the game through Steam. If you are one of these players, please share how you were able to resolve the issue.

Our other suggestions to attempt if you are still experiencing this issue:

[b]1. Restart the Steam client in Administrator Mode.[/b]

[b]2. Re-install Rumble Fighter:[/b]
[list][*]To do this, visit your Steam Library, right click Rumble Fighter and select "Properties". Click the "Local Files" tab and click "Delete Local Game Content". Afterwards, re-install Rumble Fighter.[/list]

[b]3. Compatibility:[/b]
[list][*]Right click on Steam.exe ([i]Default location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam[/i]) and select "Properties". Click the "Compatibility" tab and select "Run this program as an administrator". Click "Apply" and "OK".

[*]Right click on rumblefighter.exe ([i]Default location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\RumbleFighter[/i]) and select "Properties". Click the "Compatibility" tab and select "Run this program as an administrator". Click "Apply" and "OK".

[*]Right click on RumbleLauncher.exe ([i]Default location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\RumbleFighter[/i]) and select "Properties". Click the "Compatibility" tab and select "Run this program as an administrator". Click "Apply" and "OK".[/list]

notes.title: [EVENT] For Hire: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/c7702e7742b4dd4ac3ef12c615fa7b483404fac1.png[/img]

Now that he's finished carting around the jolly red guy for the year, Rudolph is offering his services on the battle field AND the fashion field!

[b]Rules:[/b]
- Spend Rumble Fighter Carats in-game.
- Spend enough to reach the prize tiers.
- Prizes/tiers are cumulative.
     - Example: If you spend 60,000 Carats, you will receive all the prizes.
- If you gift an item, the carat count will go towards you, not your gift receiver.
- All Carats spent from December 29, 2016 - January 2, 2017 will count towards your total.


[b]Prizes:[/b]

notes.title: Connecting RedFox Games' Rumble Fighter to Steam
notes.content:
RedFox Games' Rumble Fighter will be available through Steam starting December 16, 2016 at 11:00 PST. Follow this quick guide to connect your RedFox Games account to Steam!

==========[b]NOTICE[/b]=============
[u]Once you have connected your RedFox Games account to a Steam account, it cannot be un-linked, so please make note of this![/u]
==============================

1. Download Rumble Fighter from Steam.

2. Go to your Library and click "[b]PLAY[/b]".
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/31437f1cda0eb003428f0f7209f99556178c5a66.png[/img]

3. A login box will appear. Type in your RedFox Games account information and click "[b]LOGIN[/b]".
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/a207ff8e98551b1700302f2129f3d97278718603.png[/img]

4. Rumble Fighter will then launch the launcher to check for any patches. Note: Please allow the launcher to complete patching before moving on to the next step.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/08d3558324fa2ad7d07187c88dc36585bbf70062.png[/img]

And you're done! Enjoy!


[b]Logging onto Rumble Fighter through Steam afterwards:[/b]
After you have connected your account, you will only need to launch Rumble Fighter from Steam. Your client will automatically patch and log you into the game. Super easy!

[url=https://help.playredfox.com/support/tickets/new]If you need assistance with any portion of the installation process, don't be afraid to send a help desk ticket.[/url]
